sample_unit: early-career clinicians (benchmark comparators); 10 LLMs rated transcripts of 3 simulated interviews across 100 AMDP items

links.outcome: LLM accuracy versus early-career clinicians on AMDP item-level psychopathological assessment
links.effect: GPT-5.1 and Gemini-3-Pro-Preview accuracy 0.72 (64th percentile of clinicians); GPT-5.1 per-scenario 0.81/0.76/0.60 vs clinician means 0.79/0.68/0.58.
links.quote: GPT-5.1, selected for a marginal advantage, showed per-scenario accuracies of 0.81 (depression), 0.76 (mania), and 0.60 (schizophrenia) versus clinician means of 0.79, 0.68, and 0.58.

links.outcome: Rate of LLMs flagging items as 'not assessable' versus clinicians on text-assessable items
links.effect: LLMs more conservatively flagged items as not assessable, including text-assessable items (19.4% vs. 11.4%, p < 0.001).
links.quote: Clinicians and LLMs showed distinct error profiles: clinicians tended to over-infer symptom presence, whereas LLMs more conservatively flagged items as "not assessable" - most pronounced for observation-dependent items but present even for text-assessable items (19.4% vs. 11.4%, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Accuracy of simulated disagreement resolutions with LLM or board-certified supervision versus unsupervised clinician selection
links.effect: In 2091 clinician pairs (35.5% disagreements), LLM and board-certified supervision gave more accurate resolutions than unsupervised random clinician selection (p < 0.0002).
links.quote: In post hoc simulated disagreement resolutions (2091 clinician pairs; 35.5% disagreements), LLM and board-certified supervision were associated with more accurate resolutions than unsupervised random clinician selection (p < 0.0002).

unlisted_practices: Providing AMDP definitions as context in prompts
Majority voting across three LLM runs to improve accuracy

screen.reason: The study benchmarks the performance of multiple LLMs against 108 clinicians on standardized psychopathological rating scales using simulated psychiatric interviews, evaluating baseline accuracy and error profiles without testing a real-world deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
